amendment.boundary: A predeclared post-diagnosis measurement sensitivity on this one-seed grid, not feature selection, causal mediation, functional dimension utility or an optimizer verdict. Report every original/exact correspondence and every undefined state.

measurement_rules.adamw_comparators: All four AdamW rates for Muon/NorMuon; all other three AdamW rates for AdamW; exact equal rate weights
measurement_rules.causal_boundary: Weight displacement rank/subspaces alone are neither functional embedding-dimension utility nor a causal explanation of retrieval quality
measurement_rules.comparison: Report all five original/exact correspondences and coverage, regardless of predictive result; differences can include named estimand changes, not just numerical approximation
measurement_rules.complete_population: All twelve rates and all five stages; no selection by validation, BEIR, feature magnitude or support
measurement_rules.entropy: Full singular-spectrum entropy, explicitly different from top-64 renormalized sketch entropy
measurement_rules.nonspectral_features: The original four nonspectral columns remain in the original family only; no duplicate hypothesis tests
measurement_rules.rank_denominator: Parameter-weighted means over all nonzero hidden matrices; expose mass; never silently equate with original zero-imputed averages
measurement_rules.undefined_comparator: If any required complete pair mean is undefined, the whole focal mean is undefined; never use resolved-only conditional overlap or drop a comparator
measurement_rules.zero_or_unsafe: Retain zero/unsupported/unresolved population mass and reasons; missing rows remain errors rather than an allowed undefined value

numerical_policy.association: Exact rational baseline residuals and average-rank ties; zero residual or numerically unresolved nonzero feature/outcome direction has undefined association
numerical_policy.boundary: Numerical resolution is a declared input-stability convention, not statistical significance or causal identification; tiny exact improvements remain tiny
numerical_policy.display: 80-digit Decimal square roots and cancellation-safe RMSE subtraction converted to finite floats; display precision never decides improvement
numerical_policy.inputs: Every finite binary64 bridge value is its exact rational value; no decimal rounding or denominator approximation
numerical_policy.ols: Exact rational eight-column baseline and one-feature Frisch-Waugh-Lovell decomposition; no regularization
numerical_policy.redundancy: Exactly zero training residual yields baseline-equivalent predictions only if that same relation extends to every held-out row; otherwise augmented prediction is unidentified
numerical_policy.resolution: Nonzero added direction must have full rank under eps64 * max(rows,9) * leading singular value on the training-standardized augmented design
numerical_policy.standardization: Training-only affine feature standardization is algebraically eliminated using the intercept; retain its exact mean/variance and display scale
numerical_policy.support: Compare exact rational MSE; strictly lower pooled MSE and strictly lower in at least three of four folds; identical mathematical RMSE ordering
numerical_policy.undefined: Any unidentified/unresolved fold makes the full pooled augmented comparison and usefulness flag undefined; retain all rows and never pool only available folds

undefined_policy.absent_row_or_column: Error; missing coverage is not an undefined measurement
undefined_policy.baseline: Retain the exact complete baseline predictions even when a feature is undefined
undefined_policy.input_panel: Authenticate the complete original bridge panel; additional columns keep their own explicit names and do not replace any legacy feature
undefined_policy.partial_fit: Never fit on available measurements, drop a stage/rate or synthesize a feature value
undefined_policy.undefined_measurement: A legitimate None measurement retains every input row; all four augmented folds, complete pooled comparison and association for that feature are undefined
